title: Vickers Wellington DV697
memorial_details: Small stone column with tapering face and commemorative engraved rectangular brass plaque set on a circular gravel/stone base with an Australian eucalyptus tree alongside in honour of the two RAAF crewmen who died.
inscription: FLT-SGT J.W. WOODS RAAF/ SGT I.W. FERGUSON RAF/ SGT J.M.M. FRASER RAAF/ P-O F.P. MOORBY RAF/ DIED HERE ON / 26th SEPTEMBER 1943 / IN / WELLINGTON BOMBER NO: Dv697/ NAMED SIR GEORGE HUGGINS OBE/ DONATED BY THE/ TRINIDAD BOMBER FUND. / The Australian High Commission / have donated this / Eucalyptus Tree as a symbol/ of the homeland of these/ countrymen who perished here/ in the course of duty./ Donated by the members of the/ ROYAL BRITISH LEGION./ We will remember them./ December 2010/ R I P
community_connection: donated by the members of the ROYAL BRITISH LEGION. The Australian High Commission have donated this Eucalyptus Tree as a symbol/ of the homeland of these countrymen who perished here in the course of duty.
